nodes.description: VCA-894A, an n-of-1 antisense oligonucleotide for one compound heterozygous patient whose paternal allele carries a deep intronic variant (c.1235+894C>A) that creates a cryptic splice acceptor, so that allele's transcript is degraded by nonsense-mediated decay. The ASO blocks the cryptic acceptor to restore normal splicing, which recovers transcript from the otherwise-silent allele. In patient fibroblasts it restored wild-type transcript and raised IGHMBP2 protein by over 50%; in a chip with patient-derived iPSC motor neurons and healthy iPSC-derived muscle it reduced fatigue and chaotic tetanus. It is a 19-mer with phosphorothioate and 2'-O-MOE chemistry, matching the backbone and sugar chemistry of nusinersen, and intrathecal dosing was tolerated in a 3-month rat study with the highest dose as the NOAEL. Preclinical, and specific to this variant: it targets the sequence around c.1235+894C>A, so its intended application is variant-specific.
